description: Create frontend TypeScript types and API client functions for live match center. Define LiveMatchState, LiveEvent, LiveLineup, LiveStatistics types in frontend/src/types/live.ts. Extend frontend/src/api/client.ts with functions to call new backend endpoints (getLiveMatchDetail, getLiveEvents, getLiveLineups, getLiveStatistics). Handle errors, timeouts, and unavailable data.
steps: Read frontend/src/api/client.ts to understand existing API client pattern (request() function, ApiError class, timeout handling)
Read frontend/src/api/types.ts to understand existing type definitions (MatchResponse, MatchPredictionResponse)
Read frontend/src/types/ directory to see if live.ts already exists (investigation report mentions it)
Create or extend frontend/src/types/live.ts: Define MatchStatusType ('LIVE' | 'SCHEDULED' | 'HALF_TIME' | 'FINISHED' | 'POSTPONED' | 'CANCELLED' | 'SUSPENDED')
Define TeamInfo type: id, name, code, logo (all optional except id and name)
Define LiveStats type: shots, shotsOnTarget, shotsOutsideBox, xG, possession, corners, fouls, offsides, yellowCards, redCards, passes, passAccuracy, tackles, interceptions, saves (all optional)

Define LiveMatchState type: matchId, provider, providerMatchId, status (MatchStatusType), minute, addedTime, period, homeScore, awayScore, homeTeam, awayTeam, competition, homeStats, awayStats, dataQuality, lastUpdate (all optional except matchId and status)

Define LiveEvent type: id, type ('GOAL' | 'YELLOW_CARD' | 'RED_CARD' | 'SUBSTITUTION' | 'VAR_DECISION' | 'PENALTY' | 'OWN_GOAL'), minute, addedTime, teamId, teamName, playerId, playerName, relatedPlayerId, relatedPlayerName, description, isHome
Define PlayerInfo type: id, name, jerseyNumber, position (all optional except name)
Define LineupInfo type: teamId, teamName, formation, startingXI (PlayerInfo[]), substitutes (PlayerInfo[]), coach
Define LiveLineups type: matchId, homeLineup, awayLineup
Define LiveStatistics type: matchId, homeStats (LiveStats), awayStats (LiveStats)
Extend frontend/src/api/client.ts: Add getLiveMatchDetail(matchId: string): Promise<LiveMatchState | null> function that calls GET /api/v1/matches/{matchId}/live
Add getLiveEvents(matchId: string): Promise<LiveEvent[]> function that calls GET /api/v1/matches/{matchId}/live/events
Add getLiveLineups(matchId: string): Promise<LiveLineups | null> function that calls GET /api/v1/matches/{matchId}/live/lineups
Add getLiveStatistics(matchId: string): Promise<LiveStatistics | null> function that calls GET /api/v1/matches/{matchId}/live/stats
Update existing getLiveMatchDetail function (if it exists from previous implementation) or create it to handle null responses (match not live)
All API functions: Handle 404 (return null), handle timeout (throw ApiError with detail), handle network errors (throw ApiError)

Test API client functions manually: Start backend server, use browser console to import and call functions (import { getLiveMatchDetail } from './api/client'; getLiveMatchDetail('test_id')), verify error handling
Commit: 'feat(frontend): add TypeScript types and API client for live match center'
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/types/live.ts created or extended with all type definitions (LiveMatchState, LiveEvent, LiveLineups, LiveStatistics, TeamInfo, PlayerInfo, LiveStats)
All types use optional fields (? or | undefined) for data that may be unavailable
frontend/src/api/client.ts extended with 4 new functions (getLiveMatchDetail, getLiveEvents, getLiveLineups, getLiveStatistics)
All API functions return Promise with correct return type
All API functions handle 404 by returning null (not throwing error)
All API functions handle timeouts and network errors by throwing ApiError with detail message
TypeScript compilation succeeds: npm run build (in frontend directory) returns 0 exit code
No TypeScript errors: npx tsc --noEmit returns 0 exit code
Manual browser console test confirms functions can be called and return correct types or errors
